summary: Vir Biotechnology filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5, Rule 424(b)(5)) on November 12, 2026 for a follow-on underwritten offering of common stock, with the public offering price and share count left blank at filing. Reference price is $13.13 per share (Nasdaq close November 11, 2026); the registrant granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase additional shares at the offering price less discounts. Bookrunners are Leerink Partners, Morgan Stanley, Evercore ISI and Raymond James. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing terms, discount to last sale and use of proceeds.
